Your Account Rules on Hyperprop
Your Account Rules on Hyperprop
Updated today

Hyperprop shows your account rules while you trade. The rules themselves are ours, and they are the same on every platform.

 

Where to see your rules

Account details: go to Trading Accounts and select your account

Top bar: live gauges for how much room you have left

Order ticket: an account panel next to your orders

Your account details show:

Profit target

Daily loss limit, if your account has one

Max loss, with a badge for your drawdown type: Static, Trailing or End of day

Consistency percentage, if your account uses it

Contract limit

 

When you reach a limit

Daily loss limit (soft breach): your positions are closed and the account is locked until the next trading day. The account is not failed

Launchpad X-HYPER: the daily loss limit is a hard breach. Hitting it fails the account

Max drawdown (hard breach): the account is failed

 

Contract limit

Open positions and working orders both count toward it

10 micros count as 1 mini

If your account scales, the current figure is always in your account details

 

Your own risk settings

On the Risk Management page you can set a daily trade cap, a limit per symbol or block a symbol

You can also lock yourself out for the rest of the day

These can only make your limits stricter. They never replace our rules

 

Our rules still apply

All open trades are closed at 4:10 PM ET. Close your positions yourself before then, and do not wait for the platform to do it. See Trading Hours at Top One Futures

No overnight positions. See Can I Hold Trades Overnight?

At least one trade every 14 days. See Inactivity Rule Explained

The 10 second minimum trade time. See Minimum Trade Time Rule Explained

Everything in Prohibited Trading Practices

 

If something on Hyperprop looks different from your account rules, contact our support team before you trade.

Passing, Resets and New Accounts on Hyperprop
Passing, Resets and New Accounts on Hyperprop

What happens on Hyperprop when you pass your evaluation, reset an account or buy a new one.

Updated today

Every new account, whether you pass, reset or buy again, is a new Hyperprop account that you link the same way as your first one.

 

Passing your evaluation

Reach your profit target while meeting your account's rules.

Complete the funded steps in your dashboard: activation fee and contract, where your account type has them.

Once you have signed your trader agreement, your funded account is created on Hyperprop and you receive a new Account Ready email with your import key.

Sign in to Hyperprop. If your funded account doesn't appear automatically, import it with the new import key.

 

Resets

A reset gives you a fresh Hyperprop account with a new account number

You get a new Account Ready email for it

It links automatically if you sign in with your purchase email. If it doesn't appear, import it with the new import key

Resetting a funded account? You need to sign your trader agreement again first. Only then do you receive the Account Ready email with your new import key

Not every account can be reset. See Which Accounts Are Eligible for a Reset?

 

Several accounts

All your accounts link to the same Hyperprop login

The account limits per account type are the same as on our other platforms

 

Link every new account right away

Your inactivity period starts when the account is created, not when you link it. See Inactivity Rule Explained and How to Connect Your Account to Hyperprop.

Hyperprop Troubleshooting and FAQ
Hyperprop Troubleshooting and FAQ

Answers to the most common Hyperprop questions: linking, login, locked accounts and rejected orders.

Updated today

Most Hyperprop questions come down to linking: sign in with your purchase email, or use the import key from your Account Ready email.

 

Linking and login

My account does not show in Hyperprop

Check that you signed in with the same email you used for your purchase. If you use a different email, import the account with your import key. See How to Connect Your Account to Hyperprop.

 

I can't see my funded account, or I didn't receive my import key

Your funded account is only created on Hyperprop after you sign your trader agreement in your Top One Futures dashboard. This applies after passing your evaluation (and paying the activation fee, where your account type has one), after buying an instant funded account and after resetting a funded account. Once you have signed, you receive the Account Ready email with your account number and import key. If your funded account doesn't appear in Hyperprop automatically, import it with the import key. See How to Connect Your Account to Hyperprop. Already signed and still no email? Check your spam and promotions folders, then contact our support team with your account number.

 

I did not receive the Account Ready email

For funded accounts, this email is only sent after you sign your trader agreement. Check your spam and promotions folders. Still nothing? Contact support with your account number and we will resend it.

 

My import key does not work

Copy it again without spaces. An import key works once. If the account is already linked to another Hyperprop login, contact support.

 

Can I use the same Hyperprop login for several accounts?

Yes. All your Top One Futures accounts link to one Hyperprop login.

 

How do I sign in?

Go to app.hyperprop.com/sign-in and use your email and password, or Google, the same way you signed up

To turn on two factor authentication, go to Settings, then security, and scan the QR code with an authenticator app

 

Trading

My account is locked for the day

You reached your daily loss limit. Your account is not failed, except on Launchpad X-HYPER, where the daily loss limit is a hard breach and fails the account. Trading resumes at the start of the next trading day.

 

My order was rejected

Check these first: you are above your contract limit or scaling level (working orders count too), your market data setup is not finished (see How to Turn On Market Data on Hyperprop), or the instrument is not available for your account. Fix it and try again. Still rejected? Contact our support team with a screenshot of the rejection message.

 

There is a checklist over my chart

Your market data setup is not finished. See How to Turn On Market Data on Hyperprop.

 

The chart froze or I was logged out

Reload the page and sign in again if needed. Your balance and positions are restored. You can check whether Hyperprop is having issues at app.hyperprop.com/status.

 

Accounts

Can I switch an existing account to Hyperprop?

No. The platform is chosen at purchase. Buy a new account and choose Hyperprop. See Can I Switch My Trading Platform?

 

Does a reset keep my account number?

No. A reset creates a new Hyperprop account with a new number and a new Account Ready email.

 

Still need help?

Contact our support team with your account number, what happened, the time and a screenshot if you have one.
